items.titulo: Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents
items.resumen: Reason Machines has open-sourced Aspen, a self-hosted Git server for AI agents. It follows OpenAI’s Pando design and sustained 567 pushes per second on one 8-core server in the company’s own test. The post Reason Machines Open-Sources Aspen, a Git Server Built for AI Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .

items.titulo: 0sec Labs Open-Sources 0, an AI Security Harness With Web UI, CLI and MCP
items.resumen: 0sec Labs has open-sourced 0, an AI security harness for code review, pentesting, reverse engineering and fixes. It runs locally through a browser console, a headless CLI and an MCP server, with your own model provider.
